name: Lair

components.pose: The dragon rests half-submerged in a still tide pool, coils draped over a mound of treasure, head raised and turned toward the camera with a calm, regal gaze, water streaming from its wings.
components.background: a vast sea-cave grotto opening onto a moonlit ocean, glittering tide pools, luminous blue-green bioluminescence on the cave walls
components.hoard: strands and heaps of pearls, shipwreck treasure chests spilling coins, barnacled anchors and ship's bells, coral crowns, sapphires and sea-glass, old bottles and rusted cutlasses
components.effects: A few droplets of water hang in the air, faint bioluminescent light rippling across the hoard - understated, nothing busy.

denoise: n/a — full text-to-image, no incoming reference
notes: Daily-post lair shot: the dragon at rest on the kind of hoard its element would collect.
